selectedAssets.runtimeComposition: Original PNG backplates with separate native HTML controls and text. No generated target markers, commands, cells or instructional copy.
selectedAssets.memoryCorrection: The first generated opening was too narrow. ImageGen widened the empty recess around the existing 275 x 275 grid; cell dimensions and positions are preserved.
selectedAssets.imageProcessing: Selected PNGs are copied unchanged from the built-in generation output. Runtime layout performs display scaling; no external raster retouching was used.

visualReview.trailerMethod: All fifteen decoded frames reviewed in a contact sheet, with final encoded Injection14.5s, Memory22s and Bypass27s opened separately at full resolution. Existing reveal, room, extraction and final title remain coherent; native controls are readable beside source-registered hardware detail.
visualReview.previewMethod: All ten final decoded frames inspected separately. Three native420×650 views remain contained, with exact3× hardware crops, distinct correct/error/focus states and actual outcome receipts. The Memory crop includes its animated lower-left lamp and copper contacts. Existing achievement banners are preserved when real gameplay emits them; they can overlap receipt headings as in1.3.0, while the captured external result captions remain readable.
visualReview.motionEvidence: The full576-frame diagnostic timeline records varying real LED opacities and visible spark frames for every device. Injection:8 varying LEDs and16 spark frames. Memory:4 varying LEDs and22 spark frames. Bypass:5 varying LEDs and12 successful-stop spark frames.

independentReview.nativeRuntime: Root inspected original-size artwork, native protocol phases, eight-second quiet/peak samples and enlarged contact-spark crops before visual freeze.
independentReview.result: Root accepted the revised Memory close-up and Bypass detail in final encoded media; native games remain readable. No further media changes requested.

visualReview.audioReviewScope: Original music hashes, actual event timing, complete audio/video decoding, integrated loudness and true peak are verified. No human listening review is claimed.
visualReview.scope: Three complete native 420×650 windows plus one 384×384 hardware close-up at exact 3× nearest-neighbor scale. Live effects sampled from actual visible canvases; closed protocols retain their labeled last sample.

_publicationNote: Publication copy: local authoring paths were replaced with neutral aliases. Original measurements and outcomes are unchanged; these historical results were not rerun for the public snapshot.
